# J114: four exact homogeneous own121 nonwinners

These are NEW literal rational halfspace bodies, NOT own110 and NOT a replacement for accepted C622. All four have exact strict(S,U,H)=(1,2,1), extra weak=(0,0,0), primitive zero counts=(0,0,0), exactly one positive physical P bar and no positive polar Q bar, computed at each body's own exact uniform volume centroid. Coordinates below define the closed intersection n_i.x <= D; the origin is only an interior reference point, not assumed to be its centroid.

Scientific parent, fully read from cursor0 through EOF: immutable result figure-0585, SHA256 52b8c9ae15e764189ee5cd8b464f9806a87f19574e69536d315314d0bf318ca9. Parent endpoints are exactly KF27D_QCANCEL_ROBUST_G4 (C282 own121) and KF27D_PCANCEL_RETURN211_G10 (C270 own211). No identity or incidence is inherited by renaming. A finite relative-affine intersection supplied a seed; actual-mass polar-forest repair produced J114A; a whole-junior-component diameter-ball-cap cut family followed by finite physical mass repair produced J114B. Numerical producers are separate materials. Rational rounding defines new exact bodies, not claims about the unrounded floats.

## Reconstruction and verifier dependency
Save each complete fenced data block under its heading filename with a final LF. That alone reconstructs each exact polyhedron. For a full exact replay, use the complete unchanged exact90.cpp in the literal parent result. Its 11124 bytes have SHA256 ace049716ec9ca6a016a0001bacbf2ef3196b406bf58ee03656725a77b16fa64. The parent's complete KF27D_CAPSULE.py (84165 bytes, SHA256 0a2fb95f20d09080fdc8e47541e4c8d66a526058b615a6cd069033e38f08f90c) recovers all49 exact source files: `python KF27D_CAPSULE.py KF27D_RECOVERED`, terminal KF27D_SOURCE_CAPSULE_COMPLETE_NO_110. The decoded49-file dictionary is170846 bytes, SHA256 f465a63f1e12c1eaa71acd75a348d735f013709e555388a44fa75b5a85fccc47. This is an already durable exact source dependency, not an unavailable sandbox. A computational worker using this capsule must receive this material AND the literal parent result in parent_assignment_ids; merely mentioning that parent is not delivery.

Compile `g++ -O2 -std=c++17 KF27D_RECOVERED/exact90.cpp -lgmpxx -lgmp -o exact90`. For each NAME execute `./exact90 < NAME.txt > NAME.json 2> NAME.log`. The verifier is exact C++17/GMP arithmetic, exhaustive halfspace triples, boundedness certificates, maximal facets and true edges, two exact positive-tetrahedron mass sums, direct strict/weak face/edge/vertex census, distinct global chord-root crosschecks, and every positive physical/polar radial bar. This was executed by the coordinator, not merely proposed. Terminal markers are J90_EXACT_PASS VEF=102/153/53 SUH=1/2/1 weak=000 P=1 Q=0 for A, and VEF=118/177/61 with the same rest for each B. JSON checks field is EXACT_HULL_MASS_DIRECT_GLOBAL_CENSUS_FULL_BARS_PASS. No tolerance removes positive bars in this replay.

Environment used: GCC14.2, Python3.13.5, NumPy2.3.5, SciPy1.17.0, Torch2.10.0+cpu; only GCC/GMP are needed for the exact verification. Python consumers of exact JSON should set sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0) because centroid fractions are large.
